text: You have already built ShipFlow AI and Relvion AI — most candidates at TCS NQT haven't built anything real. You are not starting from zero.
author: Ayush's Planner

text: 474 problems sounds impossible until you do 3 per day. In about 160 days, you'll finish. The math always works if you show up.
author: Ayush's Planner

text: Every rejection email is one step closer to the yes that matters. Amazon rejected Brian Acton before he founded WhatsApp.
author: Ayush's Planner

text: Your college timetable gives you 4+ hours every evening. That's 28 hours/week. That's enough to beat anyone who 'doesn't have time.'
author: Ayush's Planner

text: August 9 is Better's deadline. August 13 is GharPayy's. The clock is running. Apply imperfect — refine later.
author: Ayush's Planner

text: VSSUT produced engineers who work at Google. The college doesn't define you — your daily 2 hours of DSA do.
author: Ayush's Planner

text: When you feel behind, open ayushdev-five.vercel.app. That's not a student portfolio — that's a professional's work.
author: Ayush's Planner

text: You are not preparing to become someone else. You are preparing to articulate who you already are — a builder who ships production software.
author: Ayush's Planner

text: DSA is the key that unlocks the door. Your portfolio is what makes them invite you in. Start tonight.
author: Ayush's Planner

text: Consistency > Intensity: 3-4 problems daily beats 10 on one day and zero the next.
author: Golden Rule

text: Timed Practice: Always use a timer. Real interviews don't wait for you.
author: Golden Rule

text: Explain Out Loud: After solving, explain your approach as if to an interviewer.
author: Golden Rule

text: Apply Early: Don't wait to feel 'ready'. Apply at 60% readiness, learn from rejections.
author: Golden Rule

text: Portfolio = Your Edge: Your production projects are stronger than 90% of candidates. Lead with them.
author: Golden Rule

text: Sunday = Rest: Burnout kills more dreams than difficulty. Rest is part of the plan.
author: Golden Rule

text: Track Everything: What gets measured gets done.
author: Golden Rule

text: It’s not about being the smartest. It’s about being the most resilient.
author: Anonymous

text: The gap between where you are and where you want to be is filled with DSA problems.
author: Anonymous

text: Keep your head down and build. The results will make the noise.
author: Anonymous

text: A year from now you will wish you had started today.
